messages:
maya: Kicking off a joint perf/W + throughput benchmark with VoltaEdge next Tue (2026-04-22) 10am PT. Primary asks: kernel tuning window, telemetry schema, test matrix, and a coordinated blog/marketplace timeline. Who can own the test plan and partner handoff?

sam: I can own kernel tuning and the run matrix. Need access to their kernel branch and kernel logs. Prefer to start with small sweeps (INT8 / FP16) then iterate.

diego: For workload shape, suggest seq lengths [512, 2048, 8192], batch sizes [1,4,8], and a steady-state throughput run (30m) to get perf/W numbers. Also log KV cache growth.

li: We'll capture perf, energy, and accuracy (LLM perplexity) across quant modes. For power we need 500ms samples + timestamps, and perf counters: sm_util, dram_bw, gpu_power. Can VoltaEdge export raw power via their power sensor API?

maya: @sam assigned for kernel tuning. @li assigned for telemetry/metrics schema. @anna can you provision the staging pool and coordinate partner creds?

anna: Yep — I'll allocate a 4xA100 staging cluster with isolated VPC and set telemetry retention to 30d. I'll also create a short runner image with the infra bits. Posting runbook fragment in a sec.

sam: Need partner to mount kernel source and a reproducible container. Requesting: kernel branch ref, docker image sha256, and a test user with sudo. Also would like a small hotfix patch space to try scheduling tweaks.

maya: Partner agreed to give a kernel branch and CI artifact. They'll only share power telemetry via an NDA CSV export initially. We'll push a sanitized dataset to our secure bucket.

li: Telemetry schema (draft): 
``` 
fields: [timestamp_ms, host_id, gpu_id, power_w, sm_util, dram_bw_MBps, temp_c, seq_len, batch_size, model, quant_mode]
sample_rate_ms: 500
```
We also want run metadata: kernel_commit, docker_sha, config_flags.

sam: For the kernel tuning cadence, propose 3 iterations: baseline, micro-tune, final. Each iteration: 3 runs per config, 30m steady-state. I'll push a checklist tomorrow.

bench-bot: Scheduled job created: joint-voltaedge-run-2775001234 at 2026-04-22T17:00:00Z (will trigger tests and collect telemetry).

diego: Quick perf command we can standardize on for the runbook: 
``` 
run_bench --model redwood-3 --seq 2048 --batch 4 --quant int8 --profile power --duration 1800 --out results.json
```
Ensure CPU pinning and NVML power sampling enabled.

anna: Pushed a minimal runbook fragment to the private repo: /infra/bench/runs/voltaedge. It includes the env vars, docker image, and a note on nvml sampling. I'll DM partner creds to the team.

maya: Marketing timeline: aim to draft joint blog + marketplace blurb within 10 days after final runs. Need a one-pager with topline numbers and partner quotes. Can growth/marketing do review once we have validated numbers?

li: We'll also produce a small eval showing no regression in ppl/accuracy across quant modes. That will go to legal for claim vetting.

sam: If we hit >1.8x perf/W improvement at 95th p99 compared to baseline FT, ops will want a canary in staging for Dedicated customers. Keep that flag in the run metadata.

maya: Cool — owners recap: sam=kernels/run matrix, li=telemetry/validation, anna=infra & partner creds, diego=workload specs, maya=partner PM + marketing sync. I'll open a private channel for partner comms and drop invites.

anna: One more ops note — enable per-route token-level latency tagging in the run so Console can show exact tail latencies per model route. Will add to runbook.

maya: Thanks everyone. Meeting invite sent for Tue 10am PT. We'll do a 30min sync before the run to confirm final artifacts. :thumbsup:
